model: Inventory-heavy developer: blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E, run as an ordinary-earnings flow at cost of equity with net debt held at zero (engine route)

inputs.share_count_basis: 13,512,466,348 ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, EPS note). No options or convertibles of consequence; the scrip-dividend option added 0.05% in the last year and is ignored. Held FLAT.
inputs.net_debt_note: net_debt is held at ZERO because the capitalised flow is ordinary earnings AFTER finance costs (RMB 6.4bn gross interest in FY2025), after tax, after NCI and after the perpetual distribution. Deducting the RMB 79.9bn company-defined net debt (borrowings 122.8bn less cash 37.3bn and restricted balances 5.5bn, 30 Jun 2026) on top would charge the debt twice. total_debt / cash / company_net_debt are recorded for the reader and for the sanity check, not used in the bridge.
inputs.last_fcf_note: last_fcf is the FY2025 flow the model capitalises: profit attributable to owners RMB 1,253.2m less RMB 661.6m distributions on the perpetual capital instrument = RMB ~592m to ORDINARY shareholders (ties to EPS RMB 0.044 x 13,507m weighted shares). reported_fcf is the FY2025 reported OCF less capex (RMB -830.9m) and is NOT the valuation base: a developer's reported FCF is land-bank timing (H1 FY2025 -8.4bn, H1 FY2026 +10.4bn).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2024 and FY2025 cash flow statements: share award scheme expense nil (FY2018-21 RMB 22-88m, trivial). SBC-zero market; house and street bases coincide and band_position collapses.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income (RMB 917m FY2025) is NOT stripped: the company is a net borrower and the capitalised earnings flow is already net of all finance income and cost.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1721, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10. Cross-check: USD/HKD 7.78 / USD/CNY 6.64 = 1.172. All statements are headed RMB'000 (every annual and interim since FY2018); only the share quote and the HK3.0-cent dividend are HKD. No dual listing exists for a parity check. Per-share values in the engine are produced in CNY and converted to HKD at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price.

ordinary_equity_anchor.note: Equity attributable to owners INCLUDES the RMB 15.2bn perpetual capital instrument issued to Sinochem HK in June 2024 (FY2025 AR note 37; it sat in NCI before 2024, which is why attributable equity jumps from RMB 39.3bn at FY2023 to 54.9bn at H1 FY2024). The NTA leg of this valuation is built on ORDINARY equity ex-perpetual, RMB 2.92/share (HKD 3.42); the price is ~0.38x that book.

inputs.wacc_rationale: This is a COST OF EQUITY, not a WACC, applied to a post-interest flow in CNY. China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.4 (HK-listed leveraged developer) x CNY ERP 6.5% = ~10.9%, rounded up to 12.0% for Ba3 leverage (Moody's ~11x), 56% effective tax leakage via land appreciation tax, and SOE related-party funding (RMB 20bn due to Sinochem entities inside adjusted capital). The same 12% is used in all three scenarios; risk is charged through the driver paths and the weights, not a per-scenario rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Lease liabilities (RMB 1.1bn) are immaterial against RMB 123bn of borrowings and are inside the earnings flow via depreciation and lease interest; nothing is added to net debt (which is zero in this model anyway).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flow is attributable to owners of the parent and then net of the perpetual distribution, so NCI (RMB 69.5bn, ~43% of FY2025 post-tax profit) and the perpetual holder are each charged exactly once through the flow. No bridge deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md routes an inventory-heavy developer to a blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E. Owner-FCF is unusable here: reported FCF is land-bank timing (-8.4bn/+10.4bn in consecutive halves) and the company is a leveraged net borrower, so an EV-less-net-debt build swings on RMB 80bn of debt against a RMB 15bn market cap. The blend is run through the engine as in the REIT/AFFO precedents (net_debt = 0, discount at cost of equity): (1) the FLOW is ordinary earnings (post-interest, post-tax, post-NCI, post-perpetual) as a % of revenue, encoded in ebitda_margin_path with D&A, capex, SBC, lease and cash-tax paths all set to 0 - the 'EBITDA margin' slider on the dashboard therefore means ORDINARY NET MARGIN; (2) the P/B leg enters through the terminal cap multiple, set where exit P/E and exit P/B / terminal ROE agree (base 7.5x = 0.5x P/B at ~7% ROE, bear 6x = ~0.25-0.3x P/B at 2-3% ROE, bull 10x = ~0.8x P/B at 9% ROE); the cap binds in every scenario because Gordon at 12%/2.5% is 10.8x; (3) the capital a developer must tie up in land and work-in-progress to grow is charged as a NEGATIVE working-capital capture on the change in revenue (net operating assets ~1.1x revenue, of which ordinary equity funds ~20-25% alongside NCI and debt): -25% base and bear, -20% bull. A shrinking revenue year releases capital, which is what H1 FY2026 OCF (+RMB 10.5bn) showed. CROSS-CHECK of the NTA leg done properly (dividends only as interim flows, exit P/B x ordinary book): base dividends ~RMB 0.4-1.5bn/yr plus 0.5x RMB ~58bn book in FY2035 gives ~HKD 1.25; the earnings leg alone with no reinvestment charge gives ~HKD 2.0; the engine build with the reinvestment charge lands between, as a blend should. FRESH BUILD (no prior DCF, no memory entry); no reconciliation block.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case through-cycle revenue growth (FY2025-FY2035 CAGR ~3.8%, terminal 2.5%); every historical CAGR is negative through the 2021-2025 China property downturn and none is a usable forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-7% 3yr, ordinary equity ex-perpetual) diverges from revenue (-11% 3yr) by less than 30% but EPS (-34% 3yr) diverges from both: the FY2023 RMB 6.9bn loss and the FY2024 perpetual distribution step-up (RMB 15bn Sinochem instrument) sit between the two. Flagged for review.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue FY2020 60,054 -> FY2022 82,991 -> FY2025 59,371. EPS FY2020 0.319 -> FY2022 0.156 -> FY2025 0.044 (RMB, after perpetual distributions). Ordinary equity (attributable less perpetual instrument) FY2020 46,762 -> FY2022 47,445 -> FY2025 38,041. FCF CAGRs are null: reported FCF is +30.1bn (FY2020), +0.8bn (FY2022), -0.8bn (FY2025) and the sign changes make a CAGR meaningless; the SBC adjustment is nil in every year. Owner FCF on the house definition equals reported FCF less zero SBC less interest income (917m FY2025), i.e. -1.7bn, and is not the flow this model capitalises.

base.ebitda_margin_note: ORDINARY NET MARGIN (post-interest, tax, NCI, perpetual). FY2025 actual 1.0%; H1 FY2026 2.6% on a 7% development gross margin. Ramps as 2024-26 land bought at ~1.4% average premium delivers at 15-18% gross margins; 4.5% terminal is one-third of FY2019's 14.9% and below FY2021's 5.2%.
base.component_note: D&A, capex, SBC, lease and cash tax are all inside the ordinary-earnings flow and are set to zero here so the engine does not charge them a second time.
base.wc_note: Land-bank / work-in-progress reinvestment: ordinary equity's share of the net operating assets a developer must add per RMB of revenue growth. Negative = growth consumes cash; a revenue decline releases it.
base.terminal_note: 7.5x ordinary earnings = exit P/B ~0.5x at a ~7% terminal ROE on RMB ~58bn ordinary book; the SOE-developer range today (Vanke 0.2x, COLI 0.4x, Poly 0.5x, CR Land 0.8x). Cap binds (Gordon 10.8x).

bull.terminal_note: 10x = exit P/B ~0.8x at ~9% ROE (CR Land territory). Cap binds (Gordon 11.4x).

bear.ebitda_margin_note: FY2027 at 0% is an impairment year (FY2023-style write-downs on the 2021-23 land bank, smaller).
bear.terminal_note: 6x ordinary earnings at a 2% net margin = ~0.2x on a book eroded to RMB ~35bn by impairments (Vanke-style discount). Cap binds (Gordon 10.2x).

scenario_narratives.base: The China residential market stops shrinking by 2027 and bifurcates toward core cities and SOE developers, which is where Jinmao's land bank sits (Beijing, Shanghai, 12 parcels in H1 FY2026 at a 1.4% average premium). Recognised revenue falls ~10% in FY2026 (H1 was -15%) then recovers in FY2027-28 as the RMB 113.5bn of FY2025 contracted sales and the growing FY2026 book deliver. Development gross margin climbs off the 7% H1 FY2026 trough as low-cost 2024-26 land replaces the 2021-23 vintages, lifting the ordinary net margin from 1-1.5% to 4.5% by FY2033. Deleveraging continues (net debt-to-adjusted capital 69% -> 52% in H1 FY2026) so growth is increasingly equity-funded, charged as a 25% reinvestment take on incremental revenue. Exit at 0.5x ordinary book / 7.5x earnings.
scenario_narratives.bull: Policy support broadens (three-red-lines relaxation, destocking purchases) and the sector troughs in 2026. Jinmao converts its top-7 contracted-sales rank into recognised revenue growth of 15-20% in FY2027-28 and the new land bank delivers 18-20% gross margins, taking ordinary net margin to 6% by FY2031 (still below FY2019-21). Second-curve income (Jinmao Services +24%, REIT recycling, >50% EBITDA-margin hotels) and lower perpetual/finance cost stop the NCI and perpetual leakage growing. Sinochem's funding advantage at 2.3-2.9% coupons widens the gap to private peers; the market re-rates SOE developers toward CR Land's ~0.8x book (10x earnings exit).
scenario_narratives.bear: The downturn runs through 2027 ('risks have not yet been cleared' - management). Revenue falls 15% in FY2026 and 5% more in FY2027; the 2021-23 land bank takes a further round of impairments in FY2027 (a smaller FY2023), wiping that year's ordinary profit and eroding ordinary book to ~RMB 35bn. Development margins settle at a 2% ordinary net margin on flat revenue. Leakage worsens: land appreciation tax keeps the effective rate above 50%, NCI takes ~45% of post-tax profit, and the RMB 662m perpetual distribution is fixed. Moody's moves below Ba3; equity exits at ~0.2x book / 6x earnings, where Vanke trades.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 35% from the 15% house default: the business is a leveraged developer (Ba3, net debt RMB 80bn against a RMB 15bn market cap) in a market management itself calls not yet cleared, with a 7% development gross margin in the latest half and a FY2023 precedent for RMB 6.9bn of impairments. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things - sector trough in 2026, margin recovery to 6%, and a sector-wide re-rating to CR Land multiples. Base 45%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A developer at 0.38x ordinary book is cheap only if the book is real and earnings recover; the model therefore values the ordinary-earnings stream at a 12% CNY cost of equity, charges land-bank reinvestment against growth, and exits at a P/B-consistent earnings multiple (0.5x book base). Net debt is in the flow, not the bridge. The Sinochem perpetual (RMB 15.2bn inside 'attributable' equity) is stripped from book and its distribution from earnings. Weighted toward the bear because the sector has not troughed and leverage is 11x.
key_risks_to_valuation: Further inventory impairments on the 2021-23 land bank (RMB 1.8bn incl. JV share in FY2025; RMB 6.9bn loss in FY2023) erode ordinary book and the P/B leg
Development gross margin stuck at the H1 FY2026 7% rather than recovering to 15-18% on new land - the base margin ramp is the single largest driver

Leakage below the attributable line: 56% effective tax (land appreciation tax), NCI ~43% of post-tax profit, fixed RMB 662m perpetual distribution; ordinary shareholders see ~12 cents of each pre-tax RMB in FY2025
Refinancing / rating: Ba3 with ~RMB 25.5bn of borrowings due within 12 months, floating-rate heavy; Sinochem support is the mitigant and also a governance exposure (RMB 20bn due to holding companies)
CNY/HKD translation (1.17) between the RMB flows and the HKD quote; a weaker RMB lowers HKD values one-for-one

Model form: capitalising ordinary earnings treats retained earnings at face value within the horizon; the reinvestment charge and the sub-1x exit P/B are what bring the result toward a dividends-plus-NTA model (~HKD 1.25 base cross-check)

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 1.15-2.04 HKD. FX CNYHKD=X same source, 2026-10-10.
data_sources.financials: 0817.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions) FY2018-FY2025 and H1 FY2023-H1 FY2026; H1 FY2026 interim report for the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet (equity attributable 54,632.2, perpetual 15,195.75, NCI 69,450.9, borrowings 122,757.9, cash 37,345.3, restricted 5,546.8, net debt 79,865.8, shares 13,512,466,348); FY2025 annual report note 37 (perpetual capital instruments), capital-management note (net debt-to-adjusted capital 69%), EPS note (ordinary profit after perpetual distribution 661.6m).
data_sources.qualitative: 0817.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-11): Sinochem SOE backing, contracted sales RMB 113.5bn FY2025 (+16%, rank 8) and RMB 57.5bn H1 FY2026 (+8%, rank 7), Moody's Ba3 downgrade, net debt-to-adjusted capital 52% at H1 FY2026, sell-side targets HKD 1.70-2.14.
